notes.title: 🚀 MAJOR UPDATE! Full HD1080 Cinematics, Audio Overhaul, UI Tweaks & More! 🎬🎶
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re beyond excited to roll out a brand-new update for NoseBound, packed with enhancements that take the game to the next level! We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and this patch delivers a series of improvements that will make your experience smoother, more immersive, and visually stunning.

Here’s what’s new:

🎥 Cinematic Overhaul – We’ve upgraded all cinematics to Full HD 1080p, bringing even more noir-style depth and detail to every scene.

🔄 Skip Cinematics & Dialogue – Tired of replaying scenes? Now you can fast-forward cutscenes and skip dialogue with the spacebar!

📝 Subtitle Toggle – Whether you prefer full immersion or subtitles for clarity, now you have full control to enable or disable them as you wish.

🎵 Fine-Tuned Audio Controls – We’ve separated the volume sliders into Music, Voices, and Sound FX, so you can adjust them independently and create the perfect balance for your experience.

🎙️ Reworked Voice Acting – Some voice lines weren’t quite hitting the mark, so we re-recorded and replaced them for a better, more polished performance.

🖋️ Improved Typography & UI Polish – We’ve refined in-game fonts for a more stylish and readable look, keeping the noir aesthetic intact.

🎨 Enhanced Visuals & Color Filters – We’ve fine-tuned lighting, color grading, and post-processing effects to better capture the gritty, cinematic tone of the game.

🛠️ Glitch Fixes & Miscellaneous Tweaks – A collection of small but important fixes to improve the overall stability and experience.

This update is a big step toward making NoseBound the best it can be, and we couldn’t have done it without your support! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these changes, and we’d love to hear your thoughts on this update.

So jump back in, explore the mysteries, and enjoy the upgraded experience! Let us know in the comments if you spot anything else—we're always listening.

Thanks for being part of our journey! More updates coming soon! 🕵️‍♂️💀

notes.title: New release date + An extra puzzle.
notes.notes:
Hello Guys and Galls! 

I have some good and bad news for you dear fans. On one hand, we need to push our release date once more. I know, I know, this sucks. But giving the context of this year, if we can release this game I would call that a miracle.  So our new release date is going to be November the 5th.
On the other hand, we are adding some last minute content. I know, I know, devs should not do that. But trust me, once you play this, you want to have this last minute puzzle in this place. And that's something that came out on the very last play-throughs. 

So, I'd like to know our audience a little bit, let's play a game. Who of you, can guess why we chose this date? I wait for your comments. 

Free keys for the first 3 that hit the answer. C'moon it's easy! 

Cheers! 
-Diego.

notes.title: New release date + New Trailer / With lots of gameplay footage.
notes.notes:
We just posted a new trailer, first one on the left. With lots of gameplay footage and puzzles, not only cinematic shots like the first teaser.  

You can watch it on youtube for better quality
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dUhHiIIuAOc&feature=youtu.be]Trailer[/url]

So you cool down while we tell you that the release date must be pushed forward to September. 

That's right. Corona virus has affected us as well, none of us has got sick by the virus, but in terms of work, clients falling off, payments not reaching, and so on. So we had to restructure our immediate goals a little bit. 
But we are firmly pushing towards September 4th this year. Hope to see you there playing the game that took so much effort to make. 

Cheers! 
-Diego.
